prompt_intro:
`repair_path` must find the shortest premise chain from `from` to `to` and
report which premises in that chain must be strengthened from `Some` to
`All`. `path` holds the premise indices in order; `strengthened` holds the
indices in that path whose quantifier was `Some`. If `from == to`, return an
empty path. If no chain exists, return `None`. Ties on length are broken by
the lexicographically smallest index sequence.
provenance: original; authored for SELVEDGE P12.9/P11.21 (S14), no public benchmark text

shared_operation.audit: author annotation only; no inter-annotator agreement yet (P11.21 gap)
shared_operation.definition: Given a target, build its dependency relation, close it from the required node while excluding already-satisfied nodes, reject a cycle as an error, and emit the minimal set of declarations to change in dependency order.
shared_operation.name: dependency-closure minimal repair
shared_operation.transfer_rule: A trio win requires success on every surface with the per-surface breakdown reported; a pooled or single-surface gain is not transfer.
